## checkGraph() function

Checks what the compiler cannot, for the application's graph test: every pair of a base in `bases` and a provider has a route; every route's paths chain from its base to its provider's entity; every route starts at a base; every loader is used; every entity whose carried attributes a load or a projection needs has a hydrator. It also lists, per pair, the relation paths of up to `maxDepth` relations (4) that no route uses, for a committed file, so that a new relation that opens a way shows in review.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function checkGraph<Meta>(graph: GraphDef<Meta>, opts: {
    readonly bases: readonly string[];
    readonly maxDepth?: number;
}): GraphCheck;
```
